obandhati: Obandhati [o + bandhati] 매다, ~에 묶다 Vin II.116 (obandhitvā ger.).
obhagga: Obhagga [o + bhagga, pp. of bhanj, Sk. avabhagna] 완전히 망가진, 깨진, 파괴된 S V.96 (°vibhagga); A IV.435 (obhaggɔobhagga); DhA I.58 (id.); J I.55 (°sarīra).
obhañjati: Obhañjati [o + bhañj] 접다, 굽히다, (옷에) 주름을 잡다; only Caus. II. obhañjāpeti J I.499 (dhovāpeti +). See also pp. obhagga.
obhata: Obhata [pp. of obharati] 가지고 간 혹은 가지고 떠난, only in cpd. °cumbaṭā with the "cumbaṭa" 떠난, 머리에 그릇을 이고 가는 여인에 대한 묘사 (on the cumbaṭa stand) Vin III.140 = VvA 73 (Hardy: "머리에 둥근 천을 올려놓고 있는 여인 "?).
obharati: Obharati [ava + bharati, cp. Sk. avabharati = Lat. aufero] 가지고 가다 또는 타다, 떠나다. -- pp. obhata.
obhāsa: Obhāsa [from obhāsati] 윤기, 광채, 빛, 광휘, 후광; 외모. 예지력에서 쓰이는 언어로 "aura" (see Cpd. 2141 with C. expln. "통찰력으로 인해 몸에서 풍겨나오는 빛") -- D I.220 (빛을 뿜어냄); M III.120, 157; A II.130, 139; IV.302; It 108 (obhāsakara); Ps I.114, 119 (paññā°); II.100, 150 sq., 159, 162; Vism 28, 41; PvA 276 (°ṁ pharati 광채를 내뿜다); Sdhp 325. With nimitta and parikathā at Vism 23; SnA 497. See also avabhāsa.
obhāsati: Obhāsati1 [o + bhāsati from bhās, cp. Sk. avabhāsati] 빛을 발하다, 빛나다 Pv I.21 (= pabhāseti vijjoteti PvA 10). -- Caus. obhāseti 빛나게 하다 혹은 빛을 뿜게 하다, 밝게 비추다, 빛으로 혹은 광채로 채우다. -- pres. obhāseti Pv III.115 (= joteti PvA 176); Miln 336; ppr. obhāsayanto Pv I.111 (= vijjotamāna PvA 56) & obhāsento Pv II.110 (= jotanto ekālokaṁ karonto PvA 71); ger. obhāsetvā S I.66; Kh v. = Sn p. 46; KhA 116 (= ābhāya pharitvā ekobhāsaṁ karitvā). -- pp. avabhāsita.
Obhāsati2 [ava + bhāsati fr. bhāṣ; Sk. apabhāṣati] ~에게 말하다 (부적절할 때), 푸념하다, 기분을 상하게 하다, 욕하다 Vin II.262; III.128.
obhāsana: Obhāsana (nt.--adj.) [fr. obhāsa, cp. Sk. avabhāsana] 빛 VvA 276 (Hardy: "누군가에게 말함").
obhoga: Obhoga [o + bhoga from bhuj to bend] 굽힌, 휘어진, 굽은, 올을 접은 Vin I.46 (obhoge kāyabandhanaṁ kātabbaṁ).
